notes: Ordered rules; the first match wins. Purpose says why a route exists.
Status says why it is or is not imported, and is overridden to BOUND for any
route the ctypes manifest actually imports.
ACTIONABLE_LOCAL means: needed by a selected deliverable and implementable now.
A capability CNA offers that this product has not selected is a deliberate
non-binding, not an outstanding task; binding a route with no consumer is not
cnb.h is a selected family: its routes are ACTIONABLE_LOCAL until bound, which
is what makes an unbound one a task rather than a decision. The two exceptions
carry their own rule and their own reason.

rules.reason: Frame generation is what XNA's two alternating frame textures need for change detection; selected for the VideoPlayer.GetTexture projection.
RenderTarget2D/Cube ContentLost is XNA public surface and CNA now has the subscription; delivery only happens on renderers that can lose a device.
XNA's GraphicsDevice constructor and Dispose are public; CNA now has an owned device rather than only the Game's borrowed one.
CNA documents that no native object pointer crosses the ABI for these events, so XNA's ResourceCreatedEventArgs.Resource cannot be supplied and would have to be fabricated.

rules.boundReason: imported: GamerServicesComponent is the one selected member of this family
rules.reason: GamerServicesComponent's three dispatcher routes are the only part of this family inside the selected profile.
A CNA test seam for resetting process-global renderer selection; shipping it as public extension surface would publish a testing hook as product API.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: the test seam is not imported

rules.reason: Renderer identity and capability reporting is the selected first extension family; evidence must name the backend that produced it.
rules.boundReason: imported: runtime capability evidence names the backend that produced it

rules.reason: These refuse instead of wrapping around when two file-declared 64-bit values are combined. Python integers are unbounded, so the same computation is already exact; calling them would convert an exact answer into a narrower one. The bound checks that do matter happen in _cna_native.cnb_support, where a value has to fit a native width.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: Python's own arithmetic is exact

rules.reason: In the selected CNB/CNJ extension family and reachable from cna.extensions.content, but not yet imported. Every remaining cnb.h route is a task, not a decision.
rules.boundReason: imported: cna.extensions.content projects CNA's own compiled content format

rules.reason: The minimal curve.h slice the CNB curve codec needs: cna_cnb_encode_curve takes a native Curve handle and cna_cnb_decode_curve produces one, so the codec is unreachable from a managed-only Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Curve. A dependency of the selected CNB profile, not a decision to bind curve.h.
rules.boundReason: imported: the CNB curve codec builds a native curve from managed keys and reads one back, destroying it before either function returns

rules.reason: The minimal content.h slice the CNB loader registry needs: cna_cnb_loader_invoke takes a content manager and refuses without one, measured rather than assumed, so a registered loader could otherwise be resolved and never run. Exactly create and destroy; no load, cache or root-directory route is bound, and this manager shares nothing with Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Content.ContentManager.
rules.boundReason: imported: cna.extensions.content.NativeContentManager is the collaborator CNA's loader signature demands

rules.reason: The CLR type name is not XNA public surface; Python names its own types, and ToString is projected separately where XNA defines it.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: no CLR type-name route is imported

rules.reason: Disposal is tracked deterministically by the Python ownership model, which is authoritative earlier than CNA's flag and stays correct after the handle is released.
rules.boundReason: imported for the Media catalog graph, whose facades are invalidated by their provider root and by Game generation rather than only by their own Dispose, so CNA's flag is the authority for whether the native object is still usable

rules.reason: These fill a caller-owned C value structure that Python already constructs directly through its measured ctypes layout.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: no value-struct initialiser is imported

rules.reason: XNA value types are implemented natively in Python against pinned XNA-derived behaviour; a per-operation C call would add a boundary crossing without adding behaviour.
rules.boundReason: not applicable: XNA value types are managed

rules.reason: In a family that backs the selected XNA profile, but outside the exact member set the 257-type projection defines; binding it would add native surface with no XNA consumer.
rules.boundReason: imported: the selected 257-type XNA projection reaches this route

rules.reason: CNA's modern engine layer is outside the selected XNA profile and outside the selected extension profile; opening it is a separate product decision, and it must never leak into Microsoft.Xna.Framework.
rules.boundReason: imported: the selected profile reaches this route

rules.reason: The strict XNA Model graph is the managed XNB one by design; CNA's native model runtime is a separate extension concept and does not replace it.
rules.boundReason: imported: the selected profile reaches this route

rules.reason: Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Content is the managed XNB reader table, cache, rollback and Unload; a CNA-native content manager is a second cache domain and belongs to the extension profile.
rules.boundReason: imported: the selected profile reaches this route

rules.reason: Sensors and device services are CNA-only capabilities outside the selected XNA profile and outside the selected extension profile.
